messages:
jamie: :rotating_light: FYI: Ubuntu 22.04 and Alpine 3.18 just received an OpenSSL fix for CVE-2026-0421. It touches libssl SONAME compatibility. We need a rebuild/remediation plan for our multiarch base images and a flow for air-gapped customer promos. Who can own triage?

nina: I can own triage. Quick q: which images are in-scope? minimal ubuntu:22.04, alpine:3.18-slim, distroless?

jamie: Primarily our minimal ubuntu:22.04 base and alpine:3.18-slim. Distroless likely ok but any containers linking to system libssl (via wheels or native extensions) might be affected. Also check our model-serving runtimes for dynamic links.

kevin: I'll sketch the rollout: ticket -> patch -> rebuild multiarch -> sign -> canary -> monitor -> promote. For private/on-prem we need an offline attestation bundle (image tar + sbom + signature).

ops-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4821 (P1). Link: https://internalsec/redwood/SEC-4821

nina: Couple questions on signing/KMS: our current signer role has broad KMS access. For air-gapped offline bundles we cannot export keys. Do we plan an ephemeral signing agent that talks to KMS SignBlob, or something else?

jamie: No key export. Proposed: run signer inside ephemeral build cluster with KMS SignBlob/Sign API. Output signature attached to image manifest. For air-gapped customers produce an 'attestation bundle' that contains signed manifest + SBOM + promote script. Security to weigh in on whether we can use short-lived certs for verification.

kevin: RBAC changes needed: tighten build-signer SA to kms:Sign only, add IAM condition restricting to resource name pattern "projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/image-signer" and to invocation project 'image-rebuilds/*'. Also require MFA for manual promotion.

security-engineer: Agree on least privilege. We'll also enable audit logging on the KMS key and ASSET inventory. Set CloudAuditLogs retention to 1y for enterprise tenants. Add runbook: block promotion if signature missing or verification fails.

jamie: Draft rebuild plan: 1) bump openssl package versions in baseimage recipes (ubuntu & alpine), preserve musl vs glibc matrix; 2) produce multiarch manifests (amd64 + arm64) in CI; 3) run smoke tests on model-serving canaries (5 nodes); 4) sign + attest; 5) promote with 24h canary window and metric thresholds for error rate and latency; 6) notify customers and update SBOMs.

nina: Regression check: soname bump will break native extensions. Add check: run ldd on common images and fail if libssl major mismatch.

kevin: Preflight snippet for CI: ```#!/bin/bash set -e
 docker run --rm "$IMAGE" ldd /app/bin/model_server | grep libssl || true
 ``` Put behind a gating job.

jamie: Air-gapped specifics: produce tarball with signed manifest, sbom.json, promote.sh that verifies signature using the public attestation key. Document offline loader steps and key rotation guidance.

security-engineer: For Ubuntu 20.04 customers we should consider backporting the patch vs full rebase. Recommend targeted libssl backport + QA if customers are pinned. We'll maintain a matrix doc of which tenants are on 20.04 and need backports.

ops-bot: Canary schedule proposed: canary-cluster 'canary-ops', start 2026-04-02T04:00Z, 5 nodes, 24h window. Alerts go to #eng-oncall.

jamie: Action items: Nina -> open PR with image/build script changes + CI matrix. Kevin -> prepare RBAC/IAM diffs and escalations for manual promotion. Security-engineer -> KMS audit playbook, attest verification, and SBOM requirements. We'll sync tomorrow 10:00am UTC. :thumbsup:
